input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the uploaded text on "\n" only, so on files with CRLF line endings (which the new Windows export tool produces) each line keeps a trailing "\r". For the header line, that means the last column name becomes "description\r", which no longer matches "description" in REQUIRED_COLUMNS, so `assertShape` reports a shape mismatch on the very first row (row 1) every time — exactly what's reported. Stripping a trailing "\r" from each line (or splitting on /\r?\n/) before parsing should fix it.
